say:1:1720306001:0.text: The curtain rises. The Hypofiend props scattered across the stage begin to pull themselves upright under your magic. The crowd breaks into cheers and applause.
say:1:1720306001:0.source_cn: 幕布拉开，舞台上歪倒散落的道具魔物在你的操控下站了起来...
say:1:1720306001:0.male: The curtain rises. The Hypofiend props scattered across the stage begin to pull themselves upright under your magic. The crowd breaks into cheers and applause.
say:1:1720306001:0.female: The curtain rises. The Hypofiend props scattered across the stage begin to pull themselves upright under your magic. The crowd breaks into cheers and applause.

say:2:1720306002:0.text: At the same time, Cassadee's clear voice rings out from center stage.
say:2:1720306002:0.source_cn: 与此同时，科丝蒂清越的声音在舞台中央响了起来——

say:4:1720306003:0.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to this special performance for the Ascension Festival.
say:4:1720306003:0.source_cn: 女士们，先生们，欢迎来到升华庆典的特别舞台。

say:5:1720306004:0.text: Tonight, we're telling a very old story.
say:5:1720306004:0.source_cn: 我们今天要讲述的，是一个非常、非常古老的故事。

say:6:1720306005:0.text: It begins long before the Lightbearer Empire is founded, before heroes are remembered by name...
say:6:1720306005:0.source_cn: 在很久很久以前，当耀光帝国还未建立，当英雄的名字尚未被...

say:7:1720306006:0.text: In those days, bloodthirsty Hypofiends roam Esperia, and people live in fear of losing everything they have.
say:7:1720306006:0.source_cn: 黑暗的阴影笼罩着大地，嗜血的魔物在伊索米亚大陆上肆虐，...

say:8:1720306007:0.text: And above all of them stands one creature the people fear most: the Mirror Wraith.
say:8:1720306007:0.source_cn: 而其中最为残暴可怖的，便是名为魔灵镜影的庞大魔物——
